title: Micromorphological Thin Section Manufacture
author: Lucia Leierer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yh8ft9w

steps.title: Dry sediment blocks
steps.instruction: Oven dry intact sediment blocks at 60 °C for 48:00:00.

steps.title: Impregnate samples with resin
steps.instruction: Impregnate the sample with a 7:3:0.1 ratio mixture of polyester resin (Palatal strained resin UN1866, TNK composites), styrene (Styrene monomer (CAS: 100-42-5) UN2055, TNK composites), and a catalyzer (Methyl-ethyl-ketone (Luperox, CAS: 78-93-3), TNK composites).

steps.title: Cut blocks into slabs
steps.instruction: After the resin has hardened, cut the blocks into 1 cm-thick slabs using a Euro-Shatal M31100 radial saw.

steps.title: Glue slabs to slides
steps.instruction: Glue the slabs onto 9 cm x 6 cm glass slides.

steps.title: Trim to 1mm thickness
steps.instruction: Trim the samples to 1mm thickness using a Uniprec ATA Brilliant-220 precision cutting machine.

steps.title: Grind to 30 µm thickness
steps.instruction: Grind the samples to 30 µm thickness using a G&N MPS-RC-Geology grinding machine.
